questions.question: Newton-Raphson method is to be used to find root of equation [latex]3x-e^{x}+\sin x=0[/latex]. If the initial trial value for the root is taken as 0.333, the next approximation for the root would be _________
questions.explanation: According to Newton-Raphson Method: [latex]  \begin{aligned}  x_{N+1}&=X_{N}-\frac{f\left ( X_{N} \right )}{{F}'\left ( X_{N} \right )} \\    f\left ( x \right )&=3x-e^{x}+\sin x \\    {f}'\left ( x \right )&=3-e^{x}+\cos x \\ \Rightarrow  \;\;  X_{1}&=X_{0}-\frac{f\left ( 0.333 \right )}{{f}'\left ( 0.333 \right )} \\    &=0.333-\frac{3\times 0.333-e^{0.333}+\sin 0.333}{3-e^{0.333}+\cos 0.333} \\ \therefore    \;\; X_{1}&=0.36 \end{aligned}[/latex]

questions.question:
X and Y are two random independent events. It is known that [latex]P(X)=0.40[/latex] and 
[latex]P(X\cup Y^{C})=0.7[/latex]. Which one of the following is the value of [latex]P(X\cup Y)[/latex] ?
questions.explanation: [latex]\; \; \; \; P\left ( X\: \cup \: Y^{c} \right )=0.7[/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )+P\left ( Y^{c} \right )-P\left ( X \right )P\left ( Y^{c} \right )=0.7[/latex] (Since X, Y are independent events) [latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )+1-P\left ( Y \right )-P\left ( X \right )\left \{ 1-P\left ( Y \right ) \right \}=0[/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )-P\left ( X\: \cap \: Y \right )=0.3\; \; \; \; \; \; ...\left ( i \right )[/latex] [latex]\; \; \; \; P\left ( X\: \cup \: Y \right )=P\left ( X \right )+P\left ( Y \right )-P\left ( X\: \cap \: Y \right )[/latex] [latex]\; \; \; \; =0.4+0.3=0.7[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
[latex]\; \; \; \; P\left ( X\: \cup \: Y^{c} \right )=0.7[/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )+P\left ( Y^{c} \right )-P\left ( X \right )P\left ( Y^{c} \right )=0.7[/latex]
(Since X, Y are independent events)
[latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )+1-P\left ( Y \right )-P\left ( X \right )\left \{ 1-P\left ( Y \right ) \right \}=0[/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \; \; P\left ( X \right )-P\left ( X\: \cap \: Y \right )=0.3\; \; \; \; \; \; ...\left ( i \right )[/latex]

[latex]\; \; \; \; =0.4+0.3=0.7[/latex]
